author: World of Warcraft
description:
Marcelian and Flame are back again, this time to tell you all about something we’ve never done in WoW until now: releasing three raids in one season. In Midnight, Voidspire, Dreamrift, and March on Quel’danas are all dropping in Season One. More raids, more loot!
